what_it_is: EVERY evidence sentence of 400 statements drawn uniformly from a 3,250,298-statement gene-gene corpus run. Each (statement, sentence) pair judged on whether that sentence ALONE backs the statement. Supersedes the one-sentence-per-statement set for any statement-grain question.
NOT_human_gold: Verdicts are LLM judgements, not human curation. Do not pool with external_curator_gold_* or eval_curation_*, and do not call them gold.

sampling.unit: statement drawn uniformly; ALL of its evidence then retrieved
